AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: This proof of concept exposes commerce device shopping through Android AppFunctions. Operational Patterns: - Use shopForDevices to start device shopping, search devices, or refine shopping preferences. - Use selectDevice to commit to a product already shown in the shopping session. - Use openSelectedDevice to open the Commerce Agent app for the selected device. Constraints: - Catalogue results come from the companion commerce backend. Session state is owned by that backend.
